thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated authentication failures for hosted endpoints in eu-central-1. Trigger: auth-rate-err-50. New incident INC-2280 created.

incident-bot: War room auto-created: https://warroom.redwood.example/INC-2280 (private). Pager sent to on-call schedule 'sre-oncall'.

pagerduty: Paging sre-oncall -> tariq (on-call).

sre-oncall: tariq here, acknowledging page and joining war room. Initial join link: https://warroom.redwood.example/INC-2280.

elena: elena (serving eng) joining. What's the symptom?

sre-oncall: 5m ago we started seeing a rising count of 401s from the auth gateway for token introspection calls. Origin seems eu-central-1 only. Error from auth-proxy: `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` in some worker logs.

deploy-bot: No recent deploys to auth-proxy or control-plane in last 120 minutes. Last deploy: control-plane@2026-09-01T02:10 (rollback not recent).

elena: certificate error? We're mid-way through automated cert rotation for internal CA in a subset of zones this morning — could be a rotation timing mismatch.

sre-oncall: confirmed: logs show `auth-service: introspect failed 500 -> tls handshake error` across multiple auth-proxy instances in eu-central-1. Client-facing symptom: users see 401 or 503 depending on gateway retries.

support-lead: Support triage: are customers seeing errors or timeouts? We need wording for the status page and which customers to notify.

product-ops: quick impact assessment: Hosted API calls requiring token introspection in eu-central-1 are affected; embedded/standalone Private deployments untouched. Some customers using EU-dedicated nodes might be impacted if their control-plane routes through affected auth proxies.

elena: mitigation plan: 1) pause cert rotation for remaining zones 2) push a fallback config that uses cached introspection results for 10s 3) roll back to previous cert bundle on the affected auth-proxies 4) publish status update. I'll take lead on steps 1-3.

sre-oncall: Tariq will confirm paging and perform the config hotflip for cached introspection. Command to apply fallback: `rwctl config set auth.introspect_cache_ttl 10 --region eu-central-1 --apply`

ops-bot: executing config change in eu-central-1. Rolling config to auth-proxy fleet: change id cfg-2280-1.

ops-bot: config change applied to 4/4 auth-proxies in eu-central-1. TTL = 10s.

sre-oncall: observing immediate reduction in failed introspections. 401s down ~60% within 90s. Good sign.

elena: submitting rollback of cert bundle to previous version on auth-proxies: `infractl cert apply --service auth-proxy --region eu-central-1 --bundle cert-v20260830`

ops-bot: cert rollback job queued. ETA ~45s for instance restarts to pick up old bundle.

deploy-bot: Note: cert-rotation job triggered by infra-automation at 2026-09-03T08:12; partial rollouts were expected. Marking automation as paused.

product-ops: draft status page update (please edit):

```
Status: Partial Outage
Service: Hosted API (eu-central-1)
Impact: Authentication failures for requests that require token introspection. Some customers may see 401 responses or failed requests. Engineers are applying mitigations including a cached introspection fallback and rolling back a recent internal certificate rotation. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or sooner.
Affected: Hosted (eu-central-1) only. Dedicated/Private deployments are unaffected unless configured to route through our eu-central-1 control plane.
```

product-ops: add to draft: link to war room and contact for enterprise escalations.

support-lead: I'll publish the status page and prepare an email for impacted customers. Draft enterprise notice: 

"Hi — we are currently experiencing authentication failures in eu-central-1 that may cause failed requests or 401 responses. Our engineers have applied a short-term fallback and are rolling back a certificate rotation. We do not believe there is any user data loss. We'll send updates in 30 minutes. If you see production impact, please reply to this message and we'll prioritize. — Redwood Support"

elena: cert rollback completed on auth-proxy fleet. Instances restarted, health checks passing. Please monitor for residual 401s.

ops-bot: Rolling restart completed (task cert-rollback-2280). Health checks: 4/4 passing.

status-bot: Public status page updated: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2280 (Draft -> Published).

sre-oncall: monitoring: 401 rate reduced to near baseline within 3 minutes after rollback + cache. Some older clients with strict token validation may still see 401 until their local caches expire.

eng-owner: I'm on call for infra. If we see any recurrence, escalate to infra oncall and open a kernel/driver investigation. Also please capture the exact cert rotation timeline for postmortem.

elena: collecting rotation logs: `infractl cert rotation history --service auth-proxy --region eu-central-1 --since 2026-09-03T06:00` -> saving to war room.

ops-bot: Saved rotation logs and snapshots: snapshots/INC-2280/2280001234-rotation.log.gz and snapshots/INC-2280/2280001234-metrics.tar.gz

support-lead: publishing to customers now and flagging any incoming tickets as P1. Also posting a short note in #partners and top-customer Slack channels.

product-ops: internal comms checklist for kickoff (template filled): 
- War room: https://warroom.redwood.example/INC-2280
- Owner: elena (serving eng)
- On-call: tariq (SRE)
- Status page: published (link above)
- Customer notifications: enterprise templates sent; support triage active
- Escalation: eng-owner oncall -> infra team

elena: handoff: I'll own the incident for the next 2 hours to verify stability and drive RCA artifacts. Tariq will monitor SLOs for 60m and then report back.

sre-oncall: I'll keep an eye on auth-introspect latency and response codes, and will revert the cache fallback after 60m of stable metrics. Command to revert: `rwctl config unset auth.introspect_cache_ttl --region eu-central-1 --apply`

eng-owner: noted. Please also collect packet captures for any TLS handshakes that failed during rotation window for forensic analysis.

ops-bot: Captures saved to: network/INC-2280/tls-handshakes-2280001234.pcap.gz

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation applied (introspection cache + cert rollback). Impact reduced. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes.

support-lead: I'll coordinate a summary email to affected customers after 60 minutes with expected next steps and a contact for dedicated assistance.

elena: thanks team. Leaving war room open for monitoring; please DM if you see any regression. :thumbsup:

end of thread
